rationale: Mutation is allowed only when deterministic writer output exactly equals canonical primary-storage input bytes.

cases.name: canonical
cases.rationale: Absolute primary path records with LF and trailing LF are canonical.

cases.name: metadata
cases.rationale: Metadata is readable but not path-only.

cases.name: relative
cases.rationale: Relative output is outside the writable profile.

cases.name: crlf
cases.rationale: Only LF line endings are writable.

cases.name: no-trailing-lf
cases.rationale: Nonempty canonical output requires trailing LF.

cases.name: blank-record
cases.rationale: Every physical record must be a nonblank path.

cases.name: malformed-utf8
cases.rationale: Writable input must decode as strict UTF-8.
